name: io.github.0xsims/rubric-mcp
description: Attested evidence tools for AI agents: sanctions screening, agent/wallet records, paid via x402.

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIC_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. USDC-on-Base wallet private key enabling paid x402 tools; without it paid tools return setup guidance.

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIC_X402_DAILY_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Daily spend ceiling in USD for paid tools (default 1.00).

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Rubric developer key for HCS-anchored attestation.
